requirement.fact: {data_dave} proposed keeping the ingestion pipeline done by hand.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: I did not volunteer to hand over my pipeline, I am asking you to admit that you are removing my manual check. You are treating my governance step as a bug to be fixed, not a control I built to protect the store data.
output.correction: You filed this as a technical preference, but I am telling you the manual verification is the only thing stopping bad scans from reaching the feature store. Do not call it a workaround, it is the current standard for data quality.
